title: 15th-16th century explorers' accounts of Amazon cities

tellings.quote: that you've heard 16th, 15th century explorers seeing these things driving your research, and then you corroborating those stories.

plain: European explorers of the 15th and 16th centuries are said to have reported seeing cities in the Amazon rainforest. Michels brings this up himself while talking with the writer Graham Hancock. In Michels's framing, those old explorers' reports drove Hancock's research, and Hancock later found evidence that backed them up, which would mean the explorers' stories were more than fantasy.
